title: PlanCraft: Sketch, Refine, and Furnish for Architect-Inspired Progressive 3D Residential Scene Generation
abstract: arXiv:2607.23491v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Two structural insights have been overlooked in automated residential floor plan generation. First, design is inherently progressive. Architects begin with rough strokes and refine them over time, whereas existing methods typically require their conditioning representation to be fully specified before generation, a fundamental mismatch with how design actually works. Second, the 2D floor plan is not an optional intermediate but an irreplaceable spatial contract. Once room boundaries, doors, and windows are fixed, furnishing reduces from open-ended spatial reasoning to bounded constraint satisfaction. Bypassing this contract, as existing 3D systems do by delegating layout to language models, yields overlapping rooms and implausible proportions; directly calling general-purpose language models likewise produces geometrically invalid layouts. Guided by these insights, we present PlanCraft. SketchPlan supplies the missing training

translated_title: PlanCraft：素描、细化与布置——受建筑师启发的渐进式3D住宅场景生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.23491v2 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：自动化住宅平面图生成领域忽视了两个结构性的洞察。首先，设计本质上是渐进式的。建筑师从粗略的草图开始并逐步细化，而现有方法通常要求其条件表示在生成之前被完全指定，这与设计的实际工作方式存在根本性的不匹配。其次，2D平面图并非可选的中间产物，而是不可替代的空间契约。一旦房间边界、门窗被固定，家具布置就从开放式的空间推理问题简化为有边界的约束满足问题。绕过这一契约——正如现有3D系统通过将布局委托给语言模型所做的那样——会导致房间重叠和比例失真；直接调用通用语言模型同样会产生几何上无效的布局。基于这些洞察，我们提出了PlanCraft。SketchPlan提供了缺失的训练（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PlanCraft提出受建筑师工作流程启发的渐进式3D住宅场景生成方法，强调设计应从粗略草图逐步细化，并将2D平面图作为不可替代的空间契约，从而避免现有方法中房间重叠和几何无效的布局问题。
en_tdlr: PlanCraft introduces an architect-inspired progressive 3D residential scene generation framework that refines designs from rough sketches and treats the 2D floor plan as an irreplaceable spatial contract, avoiding overlapping rooms and geometrically invalid layouts found in existing methods.
